body:
An attempt to fix #523332. So apparently we still need a  pam conffile, but we don't need to set the DCONF_PROFILE anymore.

@nikamarisa please let me know what email to credit you with, if you wanna be co-authored on this :)

We should probably also add a nixosTest covering gdm being used by something other than GNOME.
